title: Belawan Port Flooding — January 2021
description: Severe flooding closed Belawan Port for 12 days in January 2021. Caused by upstream Deli River overflow. Cooking oil supply to Medan disrupted; prices rose 38% in 2 weeks.

title: Trans-Sumatra Highway Landslide — November 2022
description: A massive landslide blocked the Trans-Sumatra Highway at km 147 for 7 days. Fuel supply was delayed, causing petrol and diesel prices to spike 22%, and rice prices rose 15% due to transportation delays.

title: Belawan Port Congestion Pre-Lebaran — April 2023
description: High seasonal traffic and custom clearance bottlenecks caused a 10-day delay at Belawan Port. Port queue depth exceeded 15 vessels, causing general commodity prices to rise 12%.

title: Dumai Port Strike Disruption — August 2020
description: Port workers union strike halted palm oil loading at Dumai Port for 5 days. Palm oil/cooking oil supply chains in North and Central Sumatra stalled, leading to an 18% spike in cooking oil retail prices.

title: Trans-Sumatra Highway Flooding Rantau Prapat — December 2019
description: Heavy monsoon rains caused flooding up to 1.5 meters on the Trans-Sumatra Highway near Rantau Prapat. Traffic was cut off for 6 days. Fuel trucks could not transit, causing local diesel prices to spike 30%.

title: Tanjung Balai Port Closure Cyclone — October 2021
description: A severe tropical cyclone forced the closure of Tanjung Balai Port for 8 days. Cargo operations were suspended. Rice imports and local distribution were delayed, causing a 20% increase in local rice prices.

title: Medan Distribution Hub Fire — March 2022
description: A major fire destroyed 40% of the BULOG Medan Distribution Hub. Cooking oil stocks were incinerated. Local retail prices for branded and bulk cooking oil immediately rose 25% due to panic buying.

title: Trans-Sumatra Highway Bridge Collapse Binjai — June 2018
description: An overloaded multi-axle truck caused a partial bridge collapse on the highway segment near Binjai. Heavy traffic was diverted for 15 days, causing fuel transport costs to rise, translating to a 35% local price hike.

title: Belawan Port Crane Malfunction — September 2023
description: A mechanical failure in container handling cranes at Terminal A of Belawan Port reduced container throughput by 50% for 3 days. Cooking oil export shipments delayed, causing a minor 5% price increase.

title: El Nino Drought and Wildfire — August 2023
description: El Nino weather patterns caused extreme drought and widespread wildfires in agricultural regions of North Sumatra. Rice crop yields fell 40%, causing market rice prices to rise 28% over 3 weeks.

title: Pematangsiantar Access Road Flood — May 2020
description: Flash flooding on secondary access roads leading to Pematangsiantar cut off local supply routes for 4 days. Fuel trucks had to take a 120km detour, causing local fuel prices to rise 18%.

title: Stabat Junction Congestion — October 2022
description: Severe flooding at Stabat Junction blocked the main highway link between Medan and Aceh for 3 days. Minor supply shocks occurred for perishable goods and cooking oil, leading to a temporary 6% price spike.

title: Lubuk Pakam Toll Closure Maintenance — February 2023
description: Scheduled maintenance closed the Lubuk Pakam toll exit for 2 days. Cargo traffic redirected to local arterial roads, causing minor traffic delays and a 3% increase in fuel consumption costs.

title: Kuala Tanjung New Port Disruption — July 2021
description: System integration failure during the transition of bulk cargo operations to Kuala Tanjung Port caused terminal operations to stall for 5 days. Cooking oil shipments delayed, raising regional prices 8%.

title: Trans-Sumatra Highway Rockslide Sibolga — March 2019
description: A rockslide closed the mountainous road segment linking Sibolga to Tarutung for 9 days. Fresh food and fish distribution from the coast was blocked, causing commodity prices in Tarutung/Medan to jump 40%.
